Source verification tool or technical review.

limitations: The checkout includes source, configuration, logs and textual measurements; compiled experiment artifacts are not included.
Historical checksum manifests and Git IDs identify collection-time experiment bundles. Current file identities are recorded separately from original identities.
Exact ELF inspection, complete-artifact method/study replay and frozen Git ancestry verification require the complete experiment bundles and history.
Raw protocol captures, timing receipts, deterministic replay files and historical evidence manifests retain their collection bytes; supported per-boot derivations can be checked here.
This inventory does not hash itself, authenticate historical authorship, establish clock accuracy or qualify new hardware behavior.
